scope: All nine electoral commission hubs and targeted official vacancy notices reviewed; not an exhaustive parliamentary, council or gazette audit.

facts.finding: The postal vote completion deadline, 31 October 2026 at 18:00 AEST, has elapsed. Receipt remains open until 10 November at 17:00 AEST. No result declaration was established.

Council election notice published 20 October expressly dates the councillor resignation to 14 October 2026. The 15 October resignation notice publication date is not the effective resignation date. Existing 12 December election timetable retained.

TEC update at 22:30 AEDT on 31 October says the last two deputy-mayor elections completed that day. Councillor counting adjourned and resumes 2 November. Some councillor results already final; individual outcomes not certified here.

Live Council article confirms 3 December election, nominations open 9 November and close 20 November noon; early/mobile voting begins 23 November, early voting closes 2 December 18:00; polling 3 December 08:00–18:00; scheduled declaration 17 December. Times Australia/Darwin, ACST UTC+09:30. NTEC current-election hub, last updated 6 October, still says no current elections. Council directly attributes the timetable to NTEC. Failed August round retained separately; no current candidates inferred.
